verdict.rationale: Factory's docs claim it can put "documentation on autopilot across your repos", and Droid can analyze a connected codebase, which glancingly suggests generated repo documentation. Nothing shows a queryable generated-docs interface, and nothing covers arbitrary public repositories. Missing for 10: a documented feature for querying generated documentation, support for any public (non-connected) repository, explicit private-repo doc generation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
